email.subject: Core Co Fitness: quick fix for missed calls
email.body:
Hi Dev,

I checked Core Co Fitness's site. Two things are likely costing you members: there's no click-to-call button, so mobile visitors looking at your site can't tap to call and probably just move on. The homepage images are also heavy, which slows load time on phones - the same visitors who'd otherwise sign up may bail before it finishes loading.

I run Northlight Web, fixing local business sites for a flat fee. Want a free 10-minute walkthrough where I show you exactly what I'd fix and why?

Alex
